Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Katy, Texas. Driver 1 was operating a sedan
northbound and was struck on the driver's side by a pickup operated by Driver 2, who was southbound and turning
left. Dirver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which is consistent with the force and direction of the impact. Passenger
was seated in the front passenger seat and was present at the scene. Officers and on-scene statements confirmed
Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of the crash. No independent witnesses to the collision were located.
Scene photographs confirm the general position of both vehicles and the location of the damage. The damage to the
sedan is largely consistent with the reported impact. A prior inspection photograph of the seadn shows a dent in the
same area, wihch was not addressed in either driver's account. Driver 1 reportedly lives in the same household as the
policyholder. Both drivers were cited for further review, and the investigation remains open pending follow-up.
